messages:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — starting a quick audit of the account health scoring pipeline. Noticed some CRM field mappings went stale after last ETL deploy; onboarding automation and renewal-risk flags showing gaps. Will triage now.

Chetan Rao: What specifically is broken? examples? :eyes:

Maria Lopez: Two quick ones I spotted in the logs: lots of nulls for `last_active_ts` and `usage_weekly` (these map from product_usage.weekly_active). Also `account_stage` mapping appears to have moved from sales_stage.name -> sales_stage.displayName, so our join is returning NULL.

cs-automation-bot: healthscore-refresh job FAILED 2026-02-14 03:12 UTC — error KeyError: 'account_stage'

Sara Kim: I can take the HubSpot property mapping update (will ensure `last_active_ts` and `usage_weekly` point to the correct event properties). Will also queue a re-import once Kevin's ETL guard is in.

Kevin O'Neill: I'll patch the ETL to tolerate missing fields and fallback defaults ("unknown" for strings, 0 for numerics) and add a unit test for the mapping. Pushing a small PR in ~30m.

Nora Patel: Can we pause any downstream playbook automations that fire based on healthscore change (onboarding NPS, renewal-risk emails) until we've backfilled? Don't want customers pinged with false churn alerts. :no_bell:

Maria Lopez: Agreed. Proposed plan: 1) Pause onboarding & renewal automations 2) Fix ETL mapping (Kevin) + tests 3) Update HubSpot mappings (Sara) 4) Backfill missing scores 5) Re-enable automations and monitor. Target: EOD Wed. Any objections? :thumbsup:

Chetan Rao: No objections. I'll create a Jira (CSOPS-4321) and link the PR/changes.

Sara Kim: Created the HubSpot task and added instructions for the import mapping. Also noted which properties to map to: `product_usage.weekly_active`, `last_event_ts`, `billing_tier`.

Kevin O'Neill: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/healthscore/merge_requests/87 — adds mapping guards + test. Please review.

cs-automation-bot: @channel Received command: queue healthscore-backfill. Estimated run time ~12m.

Nora Patel: I'll disable the follow-up playbook triggers now and leave a short pause note in HubSpot playbook config.

Maria Lopez: Great — once PR is merged, can someone trigger the backfill and share a quick diff of the score distribution? We just need to verify onboarding/renewal-risk buckets don't spike.

Sara Kim: Will run backfill after PR merge and post CSV sample of before/after buckets.

Chetan Rao: Adding QA checklist to the Jira: smoke test for onboarding flows, verify no automated emails sent during pause window, confirm backfilled scores match expected distribution.

Kevin O'Neill: PR merged. Running the backfill now: `/run job healthscore-backfill`

cs-automation-bot: Job queued by Kevin O'Neill. Job ID: hb-2026-0214-01. Status: RUNNING.

Maria Lopez: Thanks all. After the backfill is done, let's reconvene for 15m to confirm re-enable and monitoring thresholds.

Sara Kim: Backfill finished — sample CSV uploaded to the Jira (CSOPS-4321). No large spikes; only ~3% of accounts moved from Unknown -> Active.

Nora Patel: Re-enabled playbook automations and set a temporary monitor on renewal email rate (+alert if >2x baseline for 1h).

Maria Lopez: Perfect. Closing audit — will convert Jira into a recurring monthly quick-check to catch mapping drift. :white_check_mark:
